notes.title: Notice of Free Demo Release Delay
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the development team of Five Hearts Under One Roof.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059409/def0c33511fd5bb125f5f2b3a0ef51df54400ffa.png[/img]
We initially planned to release the demo today (August 27th), but the build review has been delayed, which will likely push the release back by at least a week. We are prioritizing the approval of the demo build and are doing our best to expedite the process.

We were excited to give players an early preview with the demo before the full release, so it is disappointing to share this news. 

Rest assured, the demo release celebration events will still proceed as planned once the demo is officially released. These events will include both Steam-exclusive and social media events.

To stay updated, please add the demo to your wishlist on the store page below, and you'll be notified as soon as the demo is available!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166530/Five_Hearts_Under_One_Roof_Demo/?beta=0][h1][Visit the Demo Store Page][/h1][/url]

We sincerely appreciate your continued support and patience, and we look forward to bringing you the demo as soon as possible.

Thank you again to everyone eagerly awaiting the release. We'll be back soon with more updates.
